author: s. t. grossman
title: Lakers name Rohan Ramadas assistant general manager of strategy and data systems
text:
The Los Angeles Lakers announced on May 26 that they have appointed Rohan Ramadas as assistant general manager of strategy and data systems, where he will oversee basketball analytics and strategic initiatives for basketball operations.
“Rohan is an important and strong addition to our front office as we further build out our basketball operations resources,” President of Basketball Operations and General Manager Rob Pelinka said in a statement. “His unique blend of career experiences and analytical expertise will further strengthen the strong work already taking place internally within our data analytics and salary cap management teams.”
Ramadas most recently served as vice president of strategy and basketball operations for the New Orleans Pelicans. He spent nine seasons with the Pelicans organization, including two years in a full-time role after seven years as an analytics consultant. Prior to his time in New Orleans, Ramadas was a draft analyst for the Miami Heat during the 2016-17 season.
In addition to his basketball experience, Ramadas has spent twelve years supporting The Aerospace Corporation, the United States Space Force, and NASA as a rocket guidance, navigation, control, and mission design engineer. According to people who know him, he is described as a literal rocket scientist.
Ramadas is originally from Cupertino, California. He holds bachelor’s and master’s degrees in astronautical engineering from the University of Southern California.
Pelinka said that Ramadas is the first of two assistant general managers being hired this offseason. “The two biggest positions that I mentioned is we will hire two assistant general managers, that’s the plan. One of those general managers would be sort of over player, draft and evaluation processes. That’s pro scouting, draft scouting, player development. The other assistant GM will be more on the strategy side, with the cap, analytics and data,” Pelinka said.
